summary: Iteration 4 (Recurring Expenses + Vendor Statement + Budget Alerts) tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 new pytest cases pass covering (a) POST /api/expenses with recurring:true returns recurring=true + recurring_id and creates a template visible on GET /api/recurring with day_of_month derived from the expense date day (7 from 2026-10-07), (b) idempotency - calling GET /api/expenses twice keeps Office Landlord Oct 2026 count at exactly 1 instance, (c) auto-generated Oct 2026 Office Landlord instance is linked via recurring_id, Unpaid, amount 25000, main_category 'Office Expenses', (d) DELETE /api/recurring/{id} soft-deletes (removed from GET /api/recurring), (e) GET /api/expenses?vendor=Office Landlord returns ONLY that vendor's bills, (f) GET /api/export?vendor=Office Landlord returns valid xlsx with content-disposition filename containing 'office-landlord' slug and every data row vendor == 'Office Landlord', (g) GET /api/dashboard?month=2026-05 budget.by_category items each include pct/budget/spent/remaining/category, (h) Milk Procurement Cost shows budget=50000, spent=55000, pct=110.0 (flaggable >=90%). Frontend (390x844 mobile): Dashboard on May 2026 shows the amber alert banner (testID=budget-alert-banner) with text '1 category needs attention - 1 over, 0 near limit' and the red Milk Procurement Cost bar with ₹55.0K/₹50.0K label; Dues screen vendor cards are tappable (dues-vendor-verka-dairy clicked), navigates to /vendor/[name] showing vendor-statement-screen with vendor-summary card (₹50,900 outstanding, 2 bills, Billed ₹55,000, Paid ₹4,100) + bill list + vendor-export button in header; Manage has 4 segments (Vendors/Categories/Budgets/Recurring) - Recurring tab shows the Office Landlord template with 'Last added Oct 2026' metadata and a stop (delete) button (testID=recurring-stop-*); Expense form (new/create mode) exposes the 'Repeat monthly' toggle (testID=form-recurring-toggle). All 10 items from the request list are verified.

react_native_issues.issue: Carry-over warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Cosmetic, web-only.
Carry-over warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Reference: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:59.

action_items: (Carry-over, non-blocking) Replace deprecated pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents in app/(tabs)/index.tsx:59 and migrate shadow* -> boxShadow for web.
(Nice-to-have) Consider validating recurring template amount >= 0 and vendor non-empty at the Pydantic layer; today a 0-amount recurring template is accepted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ensure_recurring(): called inline from GET /api/expenses and GET /api/dashboard with no concurrency lock. If two requests race on the first-ever call for a month, both could pass the 'exists' check and insert duplicate instances before last_generated is set. Low practical risk for a single-user app but worth noting; a unique index on (recurring_id, month) in db.expenses would make this airtight.

server.py create_expense recurring path: last_generated is set to the created expense's month (doc['month']), so if a user creates a recurring bill back-dated to a past month, the current real month's instance will NOT auto-generate until next month rollover. May be surprising. Consider setting last_generated to current real month in this branch.

server.py delete_recurring: soft-deletes template but does NOT delete the existing month's generated instance - which is probably intended (user may have already paid it), but worth confirming with product.
export endpoint: when both month and vendor are provided, slug uses only vendor (month ignored in filename). Minor cosmetic.

vendor/[name].tsx: tapping a bill navigates to /expense-form?id=... but the expense form screen state uses recurring toggle only in create mode (hidden on existing). Verified correct via screenshot (recurring row shows 'Auto-created monthly' badge in edit mode).
